title: Jetpacks
body:
### Dependencies
Requires [Nova](https://modrinth.com/plugin/nova-framework) ([Installation Guide](https://docs.xenondevs.xyz/nova/admin/setup/)).

# Jetpacks

![An image of a jetpack in use, alongside an image of the available jetpacks.](https://i.imgur.com/lcs0Q0F.png)

This addon adds Jetpacks of the following tiers: Basic, Advanced, Elite, Ultimate. Each Jetpack also has an armored version available, totaling a number of 8 Jetpacks. The Jetpack tiers improve upon each other with increased flight speed and energy capacity.

To charge a Jetpack, an addon that providers a charger block (such as [Machines](https://modrinth.com/plugin/nova-machines)) is required.
